# Hesiod — Theogony (Evelyn-White, 1920)

## Chicago 18 forms

**Full note:** Hesiod, *Theogony*, trans. Hugh G. Evelyn-White, in *The Homeric Hymns and Homerica* (London: William Heinemann; New York: G. P. Putnam’s Sons, 1920), lines 195–206, 933–37, 975–78.

**Shortened note:** Hesiod, *Theogony*, lines 933–37.

**Bibliography:** Hesiod. *Theogony*. Translated by Hugh G. Evelyn-White. In *The Homeric Hymns and Homerica*, 79–155. London: William Heinemann; New York: G. P. Putnam’s Sons, 1920. https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Hesiod,_the_Homeric_Hymns_and_Homerica/The_Theogony.

## Essay use

Hesiod provides genealogical provenance for the Offered image in §2/#3: Cytherea is identified as Aphrodite, and the poem’s genealogy places Harmonia in relation to Aphrodite and Ares. The image’s logic of war, love, and concord remains Taylor’s offered reading.

**Claim boundary:** the text does not establish a doctrine of dialectic, reconciliation, surveillance, two logics, or computation. It does not narrate Hephaestus’s capture of Ares and Aphrodite.

<a id="hesiod-1920-theogony-evelyn-white-q001"></a>
## Passage card — `hesiod-1920-theogony-evelyn-white-q001` — Cytherea identified with Aphrodite
^hesiod-1920-theogony-evelyn-white-q001

> “Her gods and men call Aphrodite, and the foam-born goddess and rich-crowned Cytherea, because she grew amid the foam, and Cytherea because she reached Cythera, and Cyprogenes because she was born in billowy Cyprus, and Philommedes because she sprang from the members.”

- **Locator:** *Theogony*, lines 195–206.
- **Status:** quotation-ready.
- **Verification:** Luna acquisition agent and coordinator, 2026-07-14; manually transcribed from the 1920 Wikisource text and cross-checked against the 1914 Evelyn-White text; OCR uncertainty: none.
- **Source relation:** extracted.
- **Evidential action:** supports.
- **Argument function:** mythic provenance.
- **Consumers:** [[22-s2-p3-ares-aphrodite-harmonia]]; [Hephaestus and the Net](../../../../../mytheme/worlds/hellenic/ares-aphrodite-hephaestus-poseidon/WHOLE.md); movement 22 entity identification for the genealogical sequence.
- **Use boundary:** identifies names in this translation; it does not establish a theory of Aphrodite or of love.

<a id="hesiod-1920-theogony-evelyn-white-q002"></a>
## Passage card — `hesiod-1920-theogony-evelyn-white-q002` — Harmonia in the Ares/Cytherea genealogy
^hesiod-1920-theogony-evelyn-white-q002

> “Also Cytherea bare to Ares the shield-piercer Panic and Fear, terrible gods who drive in disorder the close ranks of men in numbing war, with the help of Ares, sacker of towns; and Harmonia whom high-spirited Cadmus made his wife.”

- **Locator:** *Theogony*, lines 933–937.
- **Status:** quotation-ready.
- **Verification:** Luna acquisition agent and coordinator, 2026-07-14; manually transcribed from the 1920 Wikisource text and cross-checked against the 1914 Evelyn-White text; OCR uncertainty: none.
- **Source relation:** extracted.
- **Evidential action:** supports.
- **Argument function:** historical/mythic provenance.
- **Consumers:** [[22-s2-p3-ares-aphrodite-harmonia]]; [Hephaestus and the Net](../../../../../mytheme/worlds/hellenic/ares-aphrodite-hephaestus-poseidon/WHOLE.md); [[A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit|Trust]]; movement 22 genealogical support.
- **Use boundary:** establishes a genealogy and sequence only; it does not establish that Harmonia is an ancient doctrine of dialectic, reconciliation, or computation.

<a id="hesiod-1920-theogony-evelyn-white-q003"></a>
## Passage card — `hesiod-1920-theogony-evelyn-white-q003` — genealogy is not a theory of concord
^hesiod-1920-theogony-evelyn-white-q003

> “And Harmonia, the daughter of golden Aphrodite, bare to Cadmus Ino and Semele and fair-cheeked Agave and Autonoë whom long haired Aristaeus wedded, and Polydorus also in rich-crowned Thebe.”

- **Locator:** *Theogony*, lines 975–978.
- **Status:** quotation-ready.
- **Verification:** Luna acquisition agent and coordinator, 2026-07-14; manually transcribed from the 1920 Wikisource text and cross-checked against the 1914 Evelyn-White text; OCR uncertainty: none.
- **Source relation:** extracted.
- **Evidential action:** qualifies.

- **Consumers:** [[22-s2-p3-ares-aphrodite-harmonia]]; [Hephaestus and the Net](../../../../../mytheme/worlds/hellenic/ares-aphrodite-hephaestus-poseidon/WHOLE.md); [[A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit|Trust]]; movement 22 offered-reading boundary.
